registration.method: Robust affine least squares of exact PDF municipal outline to nearestpoints on current OSM municipal boundary. This is source-map georeferencing, not an invented neighborhood model.

municipalitySource.geometryProcessing: libosmium source-member ring assembly; no snapping, simplification, repair, clipping or generated closing edges.

geometrySource: Exact PDF line vertices; crossing noding to interpret filled paths. No clipping or buffering.
